resources.string: Uses the phone\'s Adreno GPU inside Linux (Turnip + Zink). First start downloads a ~13 MB driver. If Chromium\'s GPU process crashes, LinuxDesk switches back to software by itself. Applies at the next Start.
GPU acceleration: not supported on this GPU yet (needs an Adreno GPU, /dev/kgsl-3d0)
GPU acceleration: this phone does not let apps open the GPU device (/dev/kgsl-3d0)
GPU acceleration: needs a 64-bit ARM phone
